title: Git: merge vs rebase, bisect, recovery, PR hygiene

preview.what: Git beyond commit: merge vs rebase, bisect, undoing mistakes, clean PRs.
preview.picture: Rebase is retyping your notes onto a fresh page so history reads straight; merge staples both pages together. Bisect is finding the bad page by halving the notebook.
preview.why: Teams test whether you can recover from a bad force-push calmly.
preview.bn: Rebase = নোট নতুন পাতায় সোজা করে লেখা, merge = দুই পাতা স্ট্যাপল, bisect = অর্ধেক করে খারাপ পাতা খোঁজা।
